title: Grasp-Release Assessment of a Networked Neuroprosthesis Device
official: Grasp-Release Assessment of a Networked Neuroprosthesis Device
summary: The overall objective of this trial is to characterize the safety and effectiveness of the Networked Neuroprosthesis Device - Upper Extremity (NP-UE) in individuals living with cervical SCI.
conditions: Spinal Cord Injury at C5-C7 Level
